brand.tagline: Parts on the line, on the build.
brand.mission: Deliver committed OEM part lots reliably and on time so assembly lines stay scheduled, stays running, and no plant shuts down waiting on a supplier.
brand.vision: An automotive supply chain where line-side parts are a given, and our on-time record keeps assembly floors from ever going dark.
values: A missed part lot can stop a whole line; we treat the date accordingly.
On time is never at the expense of a defective part.
We prove every part lot against the ledger, from source to line-side.
OEMs plan around us; we make that planning safe.
Every miss is a system fix, not a blame.
brand.about: Forge Auto is an automotive OEM supplier. We take committed part-lot deliveries and land them line-side on the scheduled date — verified, traceable, right-first-time. When a whole assembly line depends on a supplier keeping the date, our on-time evidence is not a nicety; it is what keeps the plant scheduled and the warranty quiet.
history: Founded as a forge supplying drivetrain parts.
Scaled to full line-side OEM part-lot delivery.
Digitised every lot to ledger-verified on-time evidence.
leadership: Cast and forged parts his whole career before leading Forge Auto.
Owns the supply network and the on-time gate across plants.
testimonials: Forge Auto is the one supplier our line can run without watching the clock for.
brand.locations: Toledo, OH (HQ) · plants and line-side hubs serving 40+ OEM assembly sites
faq: Each committed part lot anchors to a signed ledger event with a verified delivery time — auditable from order to line-side.
Yes, JIT line-side scheduling is core, and the on-time gate applies to every committed lot.
brand.careers: Keep the line scheduled: supply chain, quality, logistics, manufacturing engineering.
brand.investors: Privately held. Plant reliability data shared with OEM customers.
brand.esg: Low-emissions forging, part-traceability for circularity, apprenticeship programs.
